[0.7368] obsidian | postgres-billing > Decision: move billing to Postgres
postgres-billing # Decision: move billing to Postgres We migrated the billing service off My
SQL because we needed JSONB columns for invoice line items and partial indexes.

graphql-n-plus-1 # Learning: GraphQL N+1 The slow orders query was making one database call
per order. A DataLoader batched them into a single query.
